statement: For every 99-by-99 symmetric binary zero-diagonal matrix A with exactly 14 ones in each integer row, put r_uv=(A^2)_uv+A_uv-2 for u<v and let F3 count all unordered residuals not divisible by 3. Then F3 is not 7. This statement alone excludes no other residual count and makes no existence, nonexistence or realization assertion about the target.

scope.description: Universal necessary exclusion of the single ternary residual count F3=7 in the complete simple symmetric zero-diagonal degree14 adjacency domain of order99. The whole connected support and all high-degree seven-edge cases are covered; only the old connected subcubic support<=12 theorem is used.

assumptions: A has order99, symmetric binary entries and zero diagonal.
Every integer row has exactly14 ones; complete common-neighbor and residual rows are used.
F3 counts all4851 unordered pairs; each modular label is identical at its two endpoints.
